definitions.explanation: Weather condition when clouds cover the sky.

examples.japanese: {今日|きょう}は{曇|くも}りです。
{明日|あした}は{曇|くも}りのち{雨|あめ}でしょう。
examples.english: Tomorrow will be cloudy, then rain.

examples.japanese: {曇|くも}りの{日|ひ}は{涼|すず}しい。

notes:
{曇|くも}り describes cloudy weather or cloudiness.

KANJI NOTE:
Both read くも but use different kanji:
- {曇|くも}り: cloudy weather
- {雲|くも}: cloud
The kanji differ by their radicals (sun vs rain).

WEATHER TERMS:
- {晴|は}れ: sunny
- {曇|くも}り: cloudy
- {雨|あめ}: rain
- {雪|ゆき}: snow

WEATHER FORECAST EXPRESSIONS:
- {曇|くも}りのち{晴|は}れ: cloudy then sunny
- {曇|くも}りのち{雨|あめ}: cloudy then rain
- {曇|くも}り{時々|ときどき}{雨|あめ}: cloudy with occasional rain
- {曇|くも}り{一時|いちじ}{雨|あめ}: cloudy with brief rain

RELATED VERB:
- {曇|くも}る: to become cloudy, to cloud over
- {空|そら}が{曇|くも}る: the sky clouds over
